title: mParivahan
developer: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
about:
mParivahan by MoRTH, Government of India. Access your RC, Driving Licence, challans, and RTO services on your phone.

Key Features:
Digital RC — Show your RC digitally
Digital DL — Carry your driving licence on your phone
Challan Management — View and pay traffic challans
RTO Services — Apply, renew, transfer online
Vehicle Details — Get complete info on any vehicle
Insurance Check — Verify vehicle insurance
Digital India — Officially recognised app

Download now to access RTO services anytime, anywhere.
